title: Grateful Dead Live at Meadowlands Arena on 1985-11-10
source: AUD> Beyer Dynamic M88's> Sony TCD5M(CM)> Nak DR-10 (Playback)> Midiman Flying Cow 24bit/48kHz A/D> RME Digi96/8> Steinberg's Wavelab 3.0 (bit resolution & resampling to CDR redbook 16/44.1> CDWav beta1.6 (tracking only)> SHNv3 (MKW ACT)

ai_review.summary: Stellar soundboard mix captures a vintage mid‑80s set with rare “Stranger” and strong second‑set classics, though some listeners find the tape hard to sit through.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard capture and high‑modulation on Bob Weir during the jam, delivering a memorable first‑set rarity (“Stranger”) and a classic mid‑80s second set (Row Jimmy, Playing in the Band, Uncle John’s Band, Comes a Time). However, one reviewer notes that the tape can be difficult to listen to, giving the overall experience a mixed feel.

ai_rating.rationale: One review rates the show and mix highly (4 stars) while another finds the recording hard to listen to (2 stars); the musical performance is generally praised, but technical issues lower the overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix described as stellar with excellent soundboard clarity and high modulation on Bob Weir; another reviewer finds the recording hard to listen to, suggesting possible tape or mastering issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Vintage mid‑80s feel; first set ends with a rare “Stranger,” second set rolls through classic mid‑era material.

band_member_comments.Bob: High modulation on Bob Weir during jam noted as a highlight.
